tests: the prediction stated in power_addendum.json, quoted there verbatim and not edited since
provenance_caveat: the prediction was written to disk BEFORE any per-set reading was taken, but it was deliberately NOT committed at that moment: `stamp_headers.sh` derives PIPEREV from `git rev-parse --short HEAD`, so a commit landing mid-chain would stamp the arm's members with a different revision from the donor's and split the A/B across two PIPEREVs for no gain. Both files therefore land in the same commit at the end. Weigh the pre-registration accordingly; what limits post-hoc shaping here is that the prediction is about the INSTRUMENT'S POWER and cannot touch the arms' outcome, and that it came out FALSIFIED.
verdict: PARTIALLY FALSIFIED — clause (1) and (2) fail, and the failure is more useful than the prediction would have been.
clause_1_per_set_se_near_set01: FAILS. set-01 0.0558/0.0708/0.0598 and set-02 0.0723/0.0680/0.0637 land where predicted; set-03 reads 0.3337/0.2974/0.1405 — as coarse as the union's 0.2871/0.3162/0.1745, on a SINGLE homogeneous -framing=min per-set stack with no mosaic in it at all.
clause_2_per_set_mutually_consistent: FAILS. set-01 vs set-02 agree at 0.1 / 1.0 / 0.5 SE, but set-03 sits 3.0 / 2.6 / 1.9 SE from set-01 and 3.0 / 2.9 / 2.1 SE from set-02.
clause_3_union_worst_of_all_four: FAILS in Red (set-03 0.3337 against the union's 0.2871), holds in Green and Blue.
what_this_kills: the proposed MECHANISM. 'The union is noisy because it is a 13-member framing=max mosaic whose sky x V residual and coverage depth vary across the canvas' cannot be the explanation, because a single-set stack carrying none of those properties is just as noisy. Mosaic heterogeneity is not what sets this instrument's power.
what_the_data_says_instead: the instrument's power tracks whether the surface carries a DETECTABLE starlight relation at all, and two of the four surfaces do not. Sorted by the control's own absolute fit: set-02 slope 26.66/37.40/31.51 at 22.0/23.4/21.3% SE, shift-null p 0.007/0.014/0.000; set-01 slope 27.11/33.03/28.02 at 21.6/27.5/25.4%, p 0.000/0.014/0.014; set-03 slope 10.39/16.42/18.00 at 67.0/64.8/41.3%, p 0.381/0.403/0.151; union slope 9.96/13.81/13.59 at 58.7/63.5/48.1%, p 0.266/0.252/0.230. The paired retained_se follows that ordering exactly. On set-03 and on the union the relation the instrument pairs against is NOT DETECTED in the control, so the pairing has little to hold on to.
not_attributed: WHY set-03 is weak is NOT settled here and is not guessed at. Facts on record, no mechanism claimed: it is the set that lost a 44-frame contiguous block to the standing auto-cull (STACKCNT 456 against 500 and 498), its catalogue plane bound is the HIGHEST of the four (14.9% against 10.0/7.5/6.4), and its Green floor span 4.40 ADU is not smaller than set-01's 4.00 — so a flatter floor is not the cause. The union contains four of set-03's members, which is a route by which it could inherit the weakness, and testing that costs a set-01+02-only compose that has not been run.
consequence_for_the_experiment: the POWERED comparison is set-01 and set-02. Those two surfaces carry retained_se 0.056-0.072, where falsifier A's 0.90 line sits at retained < 0.78-0.79 — a reachable 21-24% loss rather than the union's unreachable 67-73%. set-03 and the union are reported, and reported as UNDER-POWERED, not as nulls.
on_stack_level_at_the_per_set_surface_re: set-01 retained 1.2315/1.2740/1.2367 +- 0.0558/0.0708/0.0598 (the research pass's record, reused unchanged) and set-02 1.2184/1.1766/1.1900 +- 0.0723/0.0680/0.0637 — an independent second surface agreeing within 0.1-1.0 SE. set-03 reads 2.2531/2.0581/1.5198 +- 0.3337/0.2974/0.1405, consistent with the other two only because its own error bars are 4-6x larger.
instrument: scripts/qa/starlight_preservation.py, 14x10 external lattice, 140 cells used on every one of the four surfaces, Gaia DR3 per-cell aggregate, paired via --baseline against each surface's own control
tool_fact_worth_carrying: the Gaia TAP fetch for set-02's baseline failed once mid-run and left no record, then succeeded unchanged on a plain re-run. The instrument fails loudly and writes nothing on a partial fetch, which is the correct behaviour; budget for a retry rather than reading a missing record as a measurement.
